ezra.7.p1.b1.text: Many years later, during the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra …

ezra.7.p1.b2.text: … the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest—

ezra.7.p1.b3.text: this Ezra came up from Babylon. He was a scribe skilled in the Law of Moses, which the LORD, the God of Israel, had given. …

ezra.7.p1.b4.text: … The king had granted Ezra all his requests, for the hand of the LORD his God was upon him.

ezra.7.p2.b1.text: He had begun the journey from Babylon on the first day of the first month …

ezra.7.p2.b2.text: … and he arrived in Jerusalem on the first day of the fifth month, for the gracious hand of his God was upon him.

ezra.7.p2.b3.text: For Ezra had set his heart to study the Law of the LORD, to practice it, and to teach its statutes and ordinances in Israel.

ezra.7.p3.b1.text: Artaxerxes, king of kings. To Ezra the priest, the scribe of the Law of the God of heaven …

ezra.7.p3.b2.text: … I hereby decree that any volunteers among the Israelites in my kingdom, including the priests and Levites, may go up with you to Jerusalem.

ezra.7.p3.b3.text: Moreover, you are to take with you the silver and gold that the king and his counselors have freely offered to the God of Israel, whose dwelling is in Jerusalem

ezra.7.p3.b4.text: … up to a hundred talents of silver, a hundred cors of wheat, a hundred baths of wine, a hundred baths of olive oil, and salt without limit.

ezra.7.p3.b5.text: And be advised that you have no authority to impose tribute, duty, or toll on any of the priests, Levites, singers, doorkeepers, temple servants, or other servants of this house of God.

ezra.7.p4.b1.text: And you, Ezra, according to the wisdom of your God which you possess, are to appoint magistrates and judges to judge all the people west of the Euphrates—all who know the laws of your God. And you are to teach these laws to anyone who does not know them.

ezra.7.p4.b2.text: Blessed be the LORD, the God of our fathers, who has put into the heart of the king to so honor the house of the LORD in Jerusalem

ezra.7.p4.b3.text: … And because the hand of the LORD my God was upon me, I took courage and gathered the leaders of Israel to return with me.
